mapper.select: SELECT status FROM tl_meetings WHERE meetings_id = #{meetingId}

SELECT md.meeting_id, d.doc_id, d.original_name, d.filepath, d.mime_type, d.size, d.original_lang, d.uploaded_at, d.uploader_user_id, u.name AS uploader_name, md.added_at FROM tl_meeting_documents md JOIN tl_documents d ON d.doc_id = md.doc_id LEFT JOIN tl_users u ON u.user_id = d.uploader_user_id WHERE md.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY md.added_at DESC, d.doc_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tl_meeting_documents (meeting_id, doc_id, added_by_user_id) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{docId}, #{addedByUserId})
